category_title: Students with mild disabilities exhibiting high rates of non-responsiveness and passive off-task behavior
minimal_context: The student is expected to complete a paper-pen math worksheet during general classroom instruction.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, I have handed out the math worksheet. Please take out your pencils and start working on the problems.

STUDENT: (Looks around the classroom without taking out a pencil or looking at the worksheet.)

TUTOR: You need to get started on your assignment now.

STUDENT: (Continues to sit quietly, engaging in self-stimulation by repeatedly tapping his fingers on the edge of the desk, without raising his hand or participating in the task.)

TUTOR: Are you going to write down the answers?

STUDENT: (Displays no academic response and no task management, spending the time doing nothing and staring blankly during the paper-pen activity.)

options.A: Allow the student to work on the math worksheet at his own pace and take breaks whenever he wants.
options.B: Follow through to ensure compliance with the direction, helping him start the worksheet if he does not do it independently.
options.C: Explain the math concepts in plain and simple terms, getting straight to the point of the worksheet.
options.D: Provide specific math tasks or incorporate interactive math conditions into the current paper-pen worksheet activity.
